name: Base64 Encoder / Decoder
tagline: Encode and decode Base64 strings instantly
description: Encode plain text to Base64 or decode a Base64 string back to readable text. Essential for working with APIs, email attachments, data URIs, and tokens.

inputs.name: text
inputs.label: Input Text
inputs.placeholder: Enter text to encode or Base64 to decode...

expert_defs.name: base64_codec_convert
expert_defs.description: Encodes plain text to Base64 or decodes a Base64 string back to text. Params: text (input string, required), operation (encode or decode, default encode). Returns JSON with output_type text.

conceptTexts: Plugin: Base64 Encoder/Decoder (id: base64-codec). Expert base64_codec_convert encodes text to Base64 or decodes Base64 back to text using Python stdlib. Params: text (input string), operation (encode or decode). Returns {output_type: 'text', data: '<result>'}.
